messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (us-west-2). 5xx = 8% over last 3m, p95 latency >1200ms. Pager: @Mike Patel. Severity: S2. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gateway-errors
Mike Patel: Oncall Mike here, acknowledging. Jumping in. Any recent deploys?
Deploy Bot: deploy successful: service/gateway v2.18.3 to us-west-2 @ 1792003400 by sara.larkin.
Tess Nguyen: I saw a small canary earlier that flipped the new batching heuristic. Could be related.
Jordan Brooks: We're seeing spikes in NGINX 502s at the edge, upstream timeouts to inference-proxy.
Miguel Chen: Checking inference-proxy logs now — queues are lengthening, workers hitting 502 return when upstream model process times out. Possible KV-cache eviction thrash?
Sara Larkin: @Miguel can you paste recent stack traces? Also, any OOMs in GPU nodes?
Miguel Chen: Logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-14T15:00:12Z] inference-proxy ERROR upstream timeout after 15000ms
[2026-03-14T15:00:13Z] worker-12 WARN queue size=128 processing_time=1800ms
[2026-03-14T15:00:14Z] model-run ERROR OOM? gpu0: mem_used=142GB/160GB
```
Mike Patel: That looks like model-side slowdowns + memory pressure. Mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic from default pool to fallback smaller model, 2) kill canary/batching-heuristic flag, 3) temporarily increase worker replicas. Who can flip the feature flag?
Tess Nguyen: I can flip the flag now — flag: `enable-new-batching` -> false. Doing it.
Tess Nguyen: flipped, waiting 30s to observe.
Kara Lim: Customer ops: we have three customers reporting API 502s (one high-volume). Notified CS to send status update if persists.
Mike Patel: While flag flip propagates, I'm going to shift 40% of traffic to the fallback model (smaller-v1) via SmartRouter. Command: `rb-router shift --route /v1/generate --percent 40 --to smaller-v1 --region us-west-2`
Jordan Brooks: Shift applied. Observability: error-rate dropping to 4.5% within 90s. p95 still high ~1100ms.
Riley (oncall): Scaling inference-proxy: `kubectl scale deploy inference-proxy --replicas=10 -n prod-usw2`. Doing that now.
Deploy Bot: scale initiated by riley. Estimated readiness ~45s.
Miguel Chen: After scale, seeing worker backlog reduce and 5xx down to 1.8% — looks promising. GPU mem usage still high on a couple nodes but below OOM threshold.
Mike Patel: Good. Marking status: mitigated, customer impact reduced but not fully resolved. We'll keep monitoring for 30m. Create incident ticket and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
Sara Larkin: Opening follow-up Jira: RW-INC-2026 with summary "Transient model-side memory pressure caused gateway 5xx spike". Assigning to Miguel, priority P1.
Miguel Chen: Action item list while hot: 1) investigate root cause of mem increase (probable model leak or batch sizing), 2) add eviction/guardrail for KV cache, 3) add synthetic check for model latency and memory.
Tess Nguyen: Hotfix idea: pin canary batching to limit max_batch_size=8 and release a patch to the model-serving config. I can prepare a PR this afternoon.
Mike Patel: Also immediate runbook changes: adjust alert thresholds to include p95 >1000ms AND 5xx >3% for 5m before paging S2; add guidance to shift traffic to fallback model and scale inference-proxy. Who owns runbook edit?
Sara Larkin: I'll update runbook in docs repo and link in Jira.
Jordan Brooks: Alert tuning: current alert fires on 5xx >2% for 5m which is noisy. Recommend change to 3% and require p95 >1000ms or traffic drop. I'll file an alert PR.
Kara Lim: CS needs a short post-incident note for affected customers: timeline, mitigation, and next steps. I'll draft and loop back to Mike for signoff.
Mike Patel: Ownership summary (short-term): Miguel — root cause & telemetry (due 2026-03-17), Tess — hotfix PR for batch limiter (due EOD), Sara — runbook & Jira owner, Jordan — alert tuning PR (due tomorrow), Kara — customer comms. I'll keep this thread updated with progress.
Miguel Chen: One more log snippet I'm saving to the ticket showing memory climb correlated with batch size spikes.
Tess Nguyen: PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/4123 — includes max_batch_size guard and fallback config. Please review.
Mike Patel: Nice. After PR merges, schedule a canary with lower concurrency then monitor.
Riley (oncall): Leaving a note in oncall handoff: incident mitigated, watchlist for next shift change.
Incident Bot: Incident status changed to MONITORED by Mike Patel at 1792003570.
Mike Patel: Closing notes: we avoided wide customer outage, immediate mitigations worked (flag flip + traffic shift + scale). Root cause investigation continues. Will reopen if regression. Thanks everyone. :heart:
